import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULUS = 1000000007L;
    static long num;
    static int len, baseVal, total, index, digitArr[] = new int[110];

    static void update(int[] x, int y, int m) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= m) x[0] -= m;
    }

    static class MatrixType {
        int[][] matrix = new int[35][35];

        MatrixType() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        MatrixType multiply(MatrixType other) {
            MatrixType result = new MatrixType();
            for (int k = 0; k <= baseVal; k++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= baseVal; i++) {
                    if (matrix[i][k] != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j <= baseVal; j++) {
                            if (other.matrix[k][j] != 0) {
                                long temp = (1L * matrix[i][k] * other.matrix[k][j]) % MODULUS;
                                result.matrix[i][j] = (int) ((result.matrix[i][j] + temp) % MODULUS);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static MatrixType[][] finalAnswer = new MatrixType[1][1];
    static MatrixType[][][] sMatrices = new MatrixType[75][35][1];
    static MatrixType[][][] prefixMatrices = new MatrixType[75][35][1];
    static MatrixType[][][] suffixMatrices = new MatrixType[75][35][1];

    static void extractDigits(long number) {
        long temp = number;
        len = 0;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digitArr[++len] = (int) (temp % baseVal);
            temp /= baseVal;
        }
        // Reverse the digit array from 1 to len
        for (int i = 1; i <= len / 2; i++) {
            int tmp = digitArr[i];
            digitArr[i] = digitArr[len - i + 1];
            digitArr[len - i + 1] = tmp;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        num = sc.nextLong();
        baseVal = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize matrices
        for (int i = 0; i <= baseVal; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= baseVal; j++) {
                sMatrices[0][i] = new MatrixType[1];
                sMatrices[0][i][0] = new MatrixType();
                sMatrices[0][i][0].matrix[j][j] = 1;
                sMatrices[0][i][0].matrix[digitArr[i]][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        extractDigits(num);

        // Initialize finalAnswer as identity matrix
        finalAnswer = new MatrixType[1][1];
        finalAnswer[0][0] = new MatrixType();
        for (int i = 0; i <= baseVal; i++) {
            finalAnswer[0][0].matrix[i][i] = 1;
        }

        // Build prefix and suffix matrices
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= baseVal; j++) {
                prefixMatrices[i - 1][j] = new MatrixType[1];
                prefixMatrices[i - 1][j][0] = new MatrixType();
                prefixMatrices[i - 1][j][0].matrix = sMatrices[i - 1][j][0].matrix.clone();

                suffixMatrices[i - 1][j] = new MatrixType[1];
                suffixMatrices[i - 1][j][0] = new MatrixType();
                suffixMatrices[i - 1][j][0].matrix = sMatrices[i - 1][j][0].matrix.clone();
            }
            for (int j = 1; j < baseVal; j++) {
                prefixMatrices[i - 1][j][0] = prefixMatrices[i - 1][j - 1][0].multiply(sMatrices[i - 1][j][0]);
            }
            for (int j = baseVal - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suffixMatrices[i - 1][j][0] = sMatrices[i - 1][j][0].multiply(suffixMatrices[i - 1][j + 1][0]);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < baseVal; j++) {
                if (j != 0) {
                    sMatrices[i][j][0] = suffixMatrices[i - 1][j][0].multiply(prefixMatrices[i - 1][j - 1][0]);
                } else {
                    sMatrices[i][j][0] = suffixMatrices[i - 1][j][0];
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize finalAnswer matrix as identity
        finalAnswer[0][0] = new MatrixType();
        for (int i = 0; i <= baseVal; i++) {
            finalAnswer[0][0].matrix[i][i] = 1;
        }

        int idx = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
            if (digitArr[i] != 0) {
                int endIndex = index + digitArr[i] - 1;
                if (endIndex >= baseVal) {
                    for (int j = index; j < baseVal; j++) {
                        finalAnswer[0][0] = finalAnswer[0][0].multiply(sMatrices[len - i][j][0]);
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j <= endIndex - baseVal; j++) {
                        finalAnswer[0][0] = finalAnswer[0][0].multiply(sMatrices[len - i][j][0]);
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int j = index; j <= endIndex; j++) {
                        finalAnswer[0][0] = finalAnswer[0][0].multiply(sMatrices[len - i][j][0]);
                    }
                }
                updateIndex(index, digitArr[i], baseVal);
            }
        }

        total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= baseVal; i++) {
            total = (int) ((total + finalAnswer[0][0].matrix[i][baseVal]) % MODULUS);
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }

    static void updateIndex(int[] indexRef, int y, int m) {
        indexRef[0] += y;
        if (indexRef[0] >= m) indexRef[0] -= m;
    }
}
